name: Web Browser
description: A real Chromium browser inside an EthOS window. The pages are rendered on the NAS and streamed to whatever device you are holding, so a phone, a tablet or a locked-down laptop gets a full desktop browser without installing one. Bookmarks, history and logins live in a folder on the NAS. The window is served on port 8091; a login is optional and only enabled when you set a password.
author: SyncHot

settings.label: Password (optional — leave empty for no login)

changelog: 1.0.1: the login is now optional — leave the password empty and the browser opens with no login, matching the LinuxServer image's own no-authentication default, so install no longer forces a password. 1.0.0: first release — Chromium streamed into an EthOS window on port 8091 (HTTPS with the image's own certificate, accepted once), own login, profile folder on the NAS, kiosk-hardened and capped.
